title: Retained 30-stage closed-loop test project
description: Synthetic deterministic workflow evidence for the existing one application. It is not an application, not external authority, and not inherited by a new clean job.
loadBehavior: Fetch only after Load test project; convert with current runtime schema; import through the existing importProject path.
newCleanJobBehavior: A New clean job remains an independent blank 30-stage job.

objective.exactUserObjective: Create one UTF-8 text file whose exact bytes are `MOBILE CLOSED-LOOP TEST PRODUCT\n`, whose filename is `TEST-JOB-001__PRODUCT__v002.txt`, whose byte length is 32, and whose SHA-256 is the authorized digest.

requirements.requirement: The product UTF-8 bytes shall equal the exact 32-byte sequence for `MOBILE CLOSED-LOOP TEST PRODUCT\n`.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Byte-for-byte equality with the authorized 32-byte reference.
requirements.failureCondition: Any byte differs, is missing, or is added.

requirements.requirement: The product shall contain exactly 32 UTF-8 bytes.

requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Calculated SHA-256 equals the authorized digest.
requirements.failureCondition: Calculated digest differs or cannot be established.

requirements.requirement: The finished product filename shall be exactly `TEST-JOB-001__PRODUCT__v002.txt`.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Filename equals the authorized filename character-for-character.

tests.procedure: Read product bytes and compare them byte-for-byte with the authorized UTF-8 reference.
Calculate SHA-256 over the exact product bytes.
tests.failureCondition: Digest differs or cannot be calculated.

tests.procedure: Compare the output filename to the authorized filename.

mutations.violationMode: Supply the digest of the 31-byte fixture.
Rename the file to a nonauthorized name.

productionInstruction.objective: Write the authorized exact 32 UTF-8 bytes to the authorized exact filename.
procedure: Use only the authorized UTF-8 byte sequence.
Use a binary-safe writer that preserves the final LF byte.
Do not trim, normalize, translate, or append bytes.
Save under the exact authorized filename.
Return BLOCKED if exact-byte writing or hashing is unavailable.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All four mandatory tests return SATISFIED.

defects.observedFailure: All ten initial outputs omitted the required final LF and used the pre-correction filename.
defects.earliestDefectiveLayerEvidence: TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v001 used a newline-normalizing writer; INSTRUCTION-v001 explicitly required binary-safe exact-byte preservation.
defects.correctionRequired: Replace the writer with TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v002 and rerun all affected execution and verification.

stageEvidence: STAGE 01: Initialized TEST-JOB-001 from the retained synthetic test-project specification. Exact deliverable, input inventory, unknowns, prohibitions, and INPUT-v001 were recorded.
STAGE 02: Built SOURCE-SET-v001 from the controlling test-project specification and deterministic fixture data. No current external facts were required; no authority conflict exists.
STAGE 03: Completed two research passes and extracted four mandatory obligations: exact bytes, exact byte length, exact SHA-256, and exact filename. Latest pass found no new category.
STAGE 04: Compiled REQUIREMENTS-v001 with four atomic mandatory requirements, observable satisfaction criteria, exact failure conditions, and deterministic verification methods.

STAGE 05: Audited the requirement set for duplicates, conflicts, impossible combinations, undefined terms, circular dependencies, unsupported requirements, applicability gaps, and missing verification paths. All counts are zero.
STAGE 06: Built TEST-SUITE-v001 with one deterministic test per mandatory requirement. Mandatory test coverage is 4/4 = 1.00.
STAGE 07: Built MUTATION-SUITE-v001 with four intentionally invalid fixtures. Every validator rejected its invalid fixture.
STAGE 08: Authored INSTRUCTION-DRAFT-v001 requiring the exact UTF-8 bytes, exact filename, binary-safe writing, and no normalization or trimming.

STAGE 09: Independently preflighted the instruction sentence-by-sentence. No material ambiguity, conflict, unavailable capability, unverifiable command, or traceability gap remains. Approved INSTRUCTION-v001.
STAGE 10: Froze CANDIDATE-001 / ITERATION-001 with INPUT-v001, SOURCE-SET-v001, REQUIREMENTS-v001, TEST-SUITE-v001, MUTATION-SUITE-v001, INSTRUCTION-v001, and TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v001.
STAGE 11: Ran ten independent fresh executions. All ten produced the 31-byte fixture because TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v001 stripped the final LF. Every output and context record was preserved.

STAGE 12: Independently verified all four mandatory requirements for all ten runs. Matrix size is 4 × 10 = 40 records. All forty mandatory requirement results are VIOLATED and linked to DEFECT-TEST-001.
STAGE 13: Compared all ten executions requirement-by-requirement. The failure is unanimous, deterministic, and repeated; no run was selected or discarded.
STAGE 14: Root-caused DEFECT-TEST-001 to the earliest defective layer: TOOL_DEFECT. The text writer normalized and removed the required final LF even though INSTRUCTION-v001 was correct.
STAGE 15: Added REG-TEST-001. It reproduces the pre-correction 31-byte failure and detects the required 32-byte post-correction behavior.

STAGE 16: Revised only the responsible layer from TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v001 to TOOL-CONFIGURATION-v002, using binary-safe exact-byte writing. INSTRUCTION-v001 was preserved. Downstream execution and verification were invalidated.
STAGE 17: Froze CANDIDATE-002 / ITERATION-002 and ran ten new independent fresh executions. All ten produced the exact 32-byte product and satisfied all four requirements.

STAGE 18: Calculated convergence: mandatory requirement coverage 100%, mandatory verification coverage 100%, regression success 100%, critical defects 0, major defects 0, mandatory unknowns 0, contradictions 0, ambiguities 0, unexplained variance 0.

STAGE 19: Ran an unchanged ten-execution confirmation with the exact converged versions and hashes. All forty requirement results are SATISFIED; no new defect, requirement, missed mutation, or variance exists.
STAGE 20: Froze BASELINE-TEST-001 from the unchanged confirmed candidate and preserved exact component identities and hashes.
STAGE 21: Generated PRODUCT-TEST-001 / PRODUCT-v002 in a fresh production context using the approved baseline. The controlled filename and exact product bytes were preserved.
STAGE 22: Ran all four applicable deterministic tests against the actual final product bytes. Exact bytes, byte count, SHA-256, and filename are SATISFIED.
STAGE 23: An independent semantic evaluator compared the observed product meaning with the required meaning and returned SATISFIED with exact product-location evidence.
STAGE 24: An independent adversarial reviewer tested missing LF, extra bytes, wrong name, wrong hash, hidden characters, stale version, and prior regression patterns. No unresolved defect remains.
STAGE 25: Inspected the exact plain-text delivery representation and package inventory. The one required file opens correctly and has no missing, hidden, corrupt, duplicate, or unexpected content.
STAGE 26: Separately audited process correctness and product correctness, then reconciled them. Both determinations are SATISFIED and every mandatory evidence link is present.

STAGE 27: Applied the exact release definitions. Four of four mandatory requirements have affirmative evidence, four of four mandatory validators succeeded, and no critical, major, unknown, defect, or blocker remains. Release state ACCEPTED.
STAGE 28: Recalculated SHA-256 immediately before delivery. AUDITED_SHA256 and RELEASE_SHA256 are identical, byte sizes are identical, and the exact artifact is eligible.

STAGE 29: Preserved four complete mandatory evidence chains from source → requirement → instruction → execution → product element → test → result → evidence → release decision → matching artifact hash. Coverage is 100%.

STAGE 30: Preserved DEFECT-TEST-001, REG-TEST-001, the reproducing 31-byte fixture, pre-correction failure, post-correction success, and later-baseline regression results in an append-only permanent registry.

generationRules.runs: Generate exactly runCount independent run records per phase.
generationRules.verificationMatrix: Generate one independent verification record per phase × run × requirement.
generationRules.appendixA: Generate one fresh-context launch record for every run.
generationRules.appendixB: Generate the resolved blocker for the tool capability defect.
generationRules.appendixC: Generate the closed revalidated tool-configuration change.
generationRules.appendixD: Generate the exact final release record.
generationRules.appendixE: Generate the clean new-job initialization record.
generationRules.appendixF: Generate one agent-output receipt per stage.
